text: Mulțumim! Mai poftiți pe la noi.

en: Ah, it's you. Janine dragged me here to look at Poké Dolls. ...Don't tell anyone.
Fine, I'll admit it. The bird dolls are rather well made.
A ninja must blend into a crowd. Shopping is training! ...And the dolls are cute.
Falkner says he's only here to keep me company. Hmph.
